ctx.x: No, Alexandria. I always watched that. I said, well, look, you know, what are we paying $30.00 for everyday? And I said, I can't pay that, get me one of those rooms way upstairs. He said, 'Good boy. You got this room for $8.' That was pounds, and we got paid off in pounds. So at that time that was about, pound ble was $15.00.
So I said, well, I don't go anywhere until I save something. So all right, we were friends. So the first night we started playing, we played but they didn't respond.
